name: Can I live in my home during a multi-room kitchen and bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a multi-room kitchen and bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living in your home during a multi-room remodel, especially when both the kitchen and a main bathroom are involved, can be challenging. These are essential functional spaces. While it's sometimes possible with careful planning, it often involves setting up temporary cooking and washing facilities. For significant renovations to these critical areas, many clients find temporary relocation to be a more comfortable and less disruptive option. We will discuss viable solutions with you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living at home during a kitchen and bathroom remodel is challenging; we'll discuss temporary living solutions or relocation options.
